"""Linking support for customer messages.

Converts customer-typed order references into the shop's canonical forms.
"""

import re
from typing import List

_SO_SEPARATED_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])"
    r"SO[ \t_-]*"
    r"(?P<year>\d{4})"
    r"[ \t_-]+"
    r"(?P<number>\d{1,6})"
    r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

_SO_COMPACT_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])"
    r"SO"
    r"(?P<digits>\d{5,10})"
    r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

_ORD_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])"
    r"ORD[ \t_-]*"
    r"(?P<value>[0-9A-F]{12})"
    r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

def order_refs(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Return canonical order references in *text*, in first-seen order.

    Unknown or malformed references are ignored.
    """
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []

    found = []

    for match in _SO_SEPARATED_RE.finditer(text):
        year = int(match.group("year"))
        number = int(match.group("number"))
        if year and number:
            found.append((match.start(), "SO-{0:04d}-{1:06d}".format(year, number)))

    for match in _SO_COMPACT_RE.finditer(text):
        digits = match.group("digits")
        year = int(digits[:4])
        number = int(digits[4:])
        if year and number:
            found.append((match.start(), "SO-{0:04d}-{1:06d}".format(year, number)))

    for match in _ORD_RE.finditer(text):
        found.append((match.start(), "ORD_{0}".format(match.group("value").upper())))

    found.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])

    result = []
    seen = set()
    for _, ref in found:
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            result.append(ref)
    return result

"""Utilities for linking customer messages to shop records."""

import re
from typing import List

_SO_SEPARATED = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])SO[ \t_-]*(?P<year>\d{4})[ \t_-]+(?P<number>\d{1,6})(?![A-Za-z0-9_])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_SO_COMPACT = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])SO(\d{5,10})(?![A-Za-z0-9_])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_ORD = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])ORD[ \t_-]*(?P<hex>[0-9A-F]{12})(?![A-Za-z0-9_])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

def order_refs(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Return canonical order references mentioned in *text*."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []
    found = []
    for match in _SO_SEPARATED.finditer(text):
        year = int(match.group("year"))
        number = int(match.group("number"))
        if 1000 <= year <= 9999 and 1 <= number <= 999999:
            found.append((match.start(), f"SO-{year:04d}-{number:06d}"))
    for match in _SO_COMPACT.finditer(text):
        digits = match.group(1)
        year = int(digits[:4])
        number = int(digits[4:])
        if 1000 <= year <= 9999 and 1 <= number <= 999999:
            found.append((match.start(), f"SO-{year:04d}-{number:06d}"))
    for match in _ORD.finditer(text):
        found.append((match.start(), f"ORD_{match.group('hex').upper()}"))
    found.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    result = []
    seen = set()
    for _, ref in found:
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            result.append(ref)
    return result

"""Linking support for customer messages.

Converts customer-typed order references into the shop's canonical forms.
"""

import re
from typing import List

_SO_SEPARATED_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])"
    r"SO[ \t_-]*"
    r"(?P<year>\d{4})"
    r"[ \t_-]+"
    r"(?P<number>\d{1,6})"
    r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

_SO_COMPACT_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])"
    r"SO"
    r"(?P<digits>\d{5,10})"
    r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

_ORD_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_-])"
    r"ORD[ \t_-]*"
    r"(?P<value>[0-9A-F]{12})"
    r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

def order_refs(text: str) -> List[str]:
    """Return canonical order references in *text*, in first-seen order.

    Unknown or malformed references are ignored.
    """
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return []

    found = []

    for match in _SO_SEPARATED_RE.finditer(text):
        year = int(match.group("year"))
        number = int(match.group("number"))
        if year and number:
            found.append((match.start(), "SO-{0:04d}-{1:06d}".format(year, number)))

    for match in _SO_COMPACT_RE.finditer(text):
        digits = match.group("digits")
        year = int(digits[:4])
        number = int(digits[4:])
        if year and number:
            found.append((match.start(), "SO-{0:04d}-{1:06d}".format(year, number)))

    for match in _ORD_RE.finditer(text):
        found.append((match.start(), "ORD_{0}".format(match.group("value").upper())))

    found.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])

    result = []
    seen = set()
    for _, ref in found:
        if ref not in seen:
            seen.add(ref)
            result.append(ref)
    return result
```
